sentences.en: Can you give me a brief description of the thief?
sentences.zh: 你能给我简要描述一下那个小偷吗？

sentences.en: In brief, I need money. Please lend it to me!
sentences.zh: 简单来说，我需要钱。请借给我！

sentences.en: After a brief speech the mayor fielded questions from reporters.
sentences.zh: 在做了简短的演讲之后，市长回答了记者的问题。

senses.zh: 简短的，简洁的；短暂的，暂时的
